scripts.dev: npm run setup && npm run build && npm run db:migrate && wrangler dev --config wrangler.json --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8788
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run bundle:check
scripts.dev:e2e: npm run setup && npm run fixtures && npm run build && node scripts/e2e-server.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests *.ts *.json index.html public/*.css public/*.svg public/*.webmanifest docs/*.md README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests *.ts *.json index.html public/*.css public/*.svg public/*.webmanifest docs/*.md README.md
